question: Who won the Man Booker Prize in Nov 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Douglas Stuart**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Douglas Stuart** won the Man Booker Prize in November 2020.
 
• He won the prize for his debut novel **"Shuggie Bain."**
 
• The novel is set in 1980s Glasgow and explores themes of poverty, addiction, and family dynamics.
 
• The Man Booker Prize is one of the most prestigious literary awards in the English-speaking world, awarded annually for the best original novel written in the English language and published in the UK.
 
• Douglas Stuart's win was widely celebrated for its emotional depth and powerful storytelling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Man Booker Prize was first awarded in 1969 and has since recognized many notable authors.
 
• The award aims to promote the finest in fiction by rewarding the best novel of the year, written in English and published in the United Kingdom.
 
• Previous winners include acclaimed authors such as Salman Rushdie, Margaret Atwood, and Hilary Mantel.
 
• The prize not only brings significant recognition but also boosts book sales and readership for the winning novel.
